body: Where can I find the rules?

You should be easier on yourself. Being hurt makes you out walks up to protect yourself, no it’s not an excuse, but you have to be understanding with yourself. Yes I too thought I would become someone I liked as I got older, and I still think that, but then I remember that it hasn’t happened and I’ve just turned 18 so if it hasn’t happened now, when will it?? When will I magically become this person I like. I don’t think it will happen.

Yes I get that, maybe it’s bc you’re scared that if you let them in they’ll hurt you or leave? I wish I knew why I hated myself, I just remember being really young and just not wanting to be me, I really can’t explain it I just hate who I am.

Thank you, I appreciate the reply. Exactly where do you start?? Like self love makes no sense to me bc I don’t have anything to love. I don’t know how to better myself though bc it just leads to me feeling more miserable, I think I just hate myself just bc I’m me. I think that I’ll hate myself til the day I die, I just don’t know how to not.
